```{r}
#| include: false
make_site_plot <- function(site_id){

  d <- df |> filter(site == site_id)
  cfg <- site_cfg |> filter(site == site_id)

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = month, y = err, group = 1)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = pal$base) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 0.008),
      breaks = seq(0, 0.008, by = 0.001),
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0("Site ", site_id), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = cfg$title_color, size = 14, margin = margin(b = 2)),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "#6b6b6b"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "#6b6b6b"),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 8)
    )

  if (!is.na(cfg$highlight_from)) {
    hl_from <- cfg$highlight_from
    d_hl <- d |> filter(as.integer(month) >= as.integer(factor(hl_from, levels = levels(df$month))))

    hl_col <- if (site_id %in% c("H","E","B")) pal$success else pal$watch
    p <- p + geom_line(data = d_hl, linewidth = 1.9, color = hl_col)

    if (!is.na(cfg$highlight_point_month)) {
      d_pt <- d |> filter(month == cfg$highlight_point_month)
      p <- p + geom_point(data = d_pt, size = 3.0, color = hl_col)
    }
  }

  a <- ann |> filter(site == site_id)
  if (nrow(a) > 0) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = a$x[1], y = a$y[1],
      label = a$label[1],
      color = a$color[1],
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
      size = 3.1
    )
  }

  if (site_id %in% c("D","I","A")) {
    fl <- final_labels |> filter(site == site_id)
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = fl, aes(x = month, y = err), size = 3.0, color = pal$watch) +
      annotate("text", x = "JUN", y = fl$err + 0.00065, label = fl$lbl, color = pal$watch,
               size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  }

  p <- p + coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
  return(p)
}

pH <- make_site_plot("H")
pE <- make_site_plot("E")
pB <- make_site_plot("B")

pC <- make_site_plot("C")
pG <- make_site_plot("G")
pF <- make_site_plot("F")

pD <- make_site_plot("D")
pI <- make_site_plot("I")
pA <- make_site_plot("A")

row_success <- pH + pE + pB + plot_layout(ncol = 3)
row_status  <- pC + pG + pF + plot_layout(ncol = 3)
row_watch   <- pD + pI + pA + plot_layout(ncol = 3)
```
